name: Yongcheng

queries.query: Yongcheng China official cadastral parcel map land registration natural resources bureau
queries.result: Discovery identified the official Yongcheng government site and its local Real Estate Registration Affairs Center notice. The site links the Shangqiu Natural Resources and Planning Bureau, but no public cadastral viewer or parcel-vector endpoint was found in the reachable public HTML.

queries.result: First-party Yongcheng government material confirms the Yongcheng Real Estate Registration Affairs Center publishes real-estate registration notices and the government site has a Natural Resources section. No anonymous safe parcel ID and geometry response was exposed.

freshResearch.officialViewerInspection: The official Yongcheng government home page and Natural Resources section were fetched over HTTPS and inspected for current viewer/configuration/API references. The public page contained department navigation and registration-notice links but no cadastral map service or parcel API. The linked first-party Shangqiu Natural Resources and Planning Bureau host returned HTTP 403 to an anonymous HTTPS GET. No login, CAPTCHA bypass, credentials, private token, or unsafe owner/address/titleholder field was used.
